items.title: Godot Engine Documentation
items.description: Official documentation for the Godot game engine. Learn everything from basics to advanced features.

items.title: Godot Basics Youtube Tutorial
items.description: A beginner-friendly video tutorial covering the basics of using the Godot engine for game development.

items.title: Unity Learn Platform
items.description: Free tutorials and courses for Unity development, from beginner to advanced.

items.title: Introduction to Game Development
items.description: A comprehensive video introduction to game development concepts and best practices.

items.title: Aseprite
items.description: Animated sprite editor and pixel art tool. Open source program for creating 2D animations and pixel art for games.

items.title: Unity Movement Tutorial
items.description: In-depth tutorial series on implementing movement mechanics in Unity. Learn advanced character controller techniques from Catlike Coding.

items.title: OSU VGDC Linktree
items.description: Official OSU Video Game Development Club Linktree with links to all our social media, Discord, and important resources.

items.title: Fab - Epic Games Marketplace
items.description: Epic Games' unified marketplace for 3D content, game assets, plugins, and tools. Find high-quality assets for Unreal Engine and other game engines.

items.title: Mixamo
items.description: Free 3D character animation library from Adobe. Get rigged characters and motion capture animations for your games.

items.title: OpenGameArt
items.description: Community-driven collection of free game art assets including sprites, textures, music, and sound effects for game developers.

items.title: MapMagic 2 - Unity Terrain Generator
items.description: Powerful procedural terrain generation tool for Unity. Create infinite landscapes with nodes-based editor and advanced features.

items.title: Meshy AI
items.description: AI-powered 3D model generation tool. Create 3D assets from text descriptions or images using artificial intelligence.

items.title: Free Fantasy 200 SFX Pack
items.description: Collection of 200+ free fantasy sound effects for game development. Includes spells, UI sounds, impacts, and more.

items.title: Brackeys YouTube Channel
items.description: Popular game development YouTube channel with comprehensive Unity tutorials, game design tips, and programming guides for beginners and intermediate developers.

items.title: How to Think Like a Game Designer
items.description: Learn how to analyze game mechanics using the MDA framework. This video explores how mechanics influence player actions and feelings, demonstrating how to adapt borrowed elements to your own game design. Discover how to create a cohesive experience.

items.title: GMTK YouTube Channel
items.description: Game Maker's Toolkit - in-depth video essays analyzing game design, mechanics, and what makes games work. Features weekly videos on game design theory and analysis.

items.title: How To Market A Game
items.description: Website to learn how to effectively market your game, from social media strategies to press outreach.

items.title: GDC Vault
items.description: Extensive library of game development talks, presentations, and panels from the Game Developers Conference. Learn from industry experts on a wide range of topics.

items.title: itch.io
items.description: Indie game platform for hosting, selling, and discovering independent games. Perfect for publishing game jam projects and prototypes.

items.title: Kenney Game Assets
items.description: Massive collection of free game assets including 2D sprites, 3D models, UI elements, and sound effects. All public domain.

items.title: Unreal Engine Documentation
items.description: Official comprehensive documentation for Unreal Engine. Learn blueprints, C++, rendering, and advanced engine features.

items.title: GameDev.net
items.description: Long-running game development community with articles, tutorials, forums, and resources covering programming, art, design, and business.

items.title: Polycount
items.description: Premier community for game artists and 3D modelers. Features forums, wiki, and galleries showcasing professional game art techniques.

items.title: Sebastian Lague YouTube
items.description: Excellent programming tutorials covering procedural generation, coding adventures, and game development concepts with beautiful visualizations.

items.title: Freesound
items.description: Collaborative database of Creative Commons licensed sounds. Find and share sound effects and audio samples for your game projects.

items.title: Shadertoy
items.description: Online community and tool for creating and sharing shaders. Learn shader programming through thousands of examples and live coding.

items.title: Game Programming Patterns
items.description: Free online book by Bob Nystrom covering essential software design patterns specifically for game development. Includes clear examples and explanations.

items.title: Bevy Engine
items.description: Modern, data-driven game engine built in Rust. Features ECS architecture, powerful plugin system, and excellent performance.

items.title: Chaos Game Interactive Classroom App
items.description: Interactive demo of the iterative chaos game algorithm. Adjust the number of points, rules, and ratios to watch fractals like the Sierpinski triangle emerge point by point.

items.title: Inspired by the Chaos Game
items.description: Blog post walking through the iterative chaos game algorithm with beautiful visual examples. Explores variations of the rules and the fractal patterns they produce.

items.title: Parallel Chaos Game Shader (compute.toys)
items.description: WGSL compute shader that runs the chaos game in parallel on the GPU. A great example of how a traditionally iterative algorithm can be parallelized for real-time fractal rendering.

items.title: Parallel Chaos Game Video
items.description: Video walkthrough covering a parallel GPU implementation of the chaos game. Demonstrates how to convert iterative fractal generation into a parallel computation.
